for: a deployment that applied ONLY patch/266-token-drift-fix; rolls up every post-266 customer-facing fix (former 311-rollup: #290/#298/#300/#303/#304/#305/#306/#307/#312/#314) PLUS #315 (concurrent-tenant dispatch: remove host-level inflight gate in ddb mode + host-agent reconciler race fixes + scaler idle auto-scale-down off).
note: cdk deploy is FORBIDDEN (this deployment was CDK-deployed once then hand-modified; a deploy would overwrite the manual changes). All shipped files are a byte-for-byte snapshot of the public gateway branch HEAD. APPLY-INSTRUCTIONS.md carries the commands we test-verified; the operator/AI adapts placeholders (<region>/<host>/<key>/resource names) to the target environment. Backup only the minimal set below (the files/functions this patch actually replaces) — nothing else is touched.

deploy/userdata/launch-vm.sh.why: #290/#306 token fallback + rc=127 fix, #301 default-template skip-S3, #312/#314 paired.json/vkey re-inject, #315 ddb-mode non-zero-exit keeps assignment pending. Cumulative.

deploy/userdata/host-agent.py.why: #315 reconciler race fixes (_recovering leak, failed-launch keeps pending, health-gated promote). New in #315.
deploy/userdata/host-agent.py.restart_caveat: host-agent.service has no KillMode -> default control-group -> `systemctl restart` SIGTERMs the whole cgroup and kills EVERY tenant firecracker on that host. Set KillMode=process (drop-in) BEFORE restart. See APPLY Step 4.

functions: openclaw-api (API GW -> live alias; dispatch SQS ESM -> $LATEST)
openclaw-lifecycle-consumer ($LATEST; handles start/stop/restart/rebuild/delete — create does NOT go through it since create_via_queue=false)
deploy/lambda/api/**.why: #298 private-API routing, #303/#304/#305 rebuild semantics, #312/#314 device_paired persistence, #315 dispatch (clients/binpack/dispatch_poller/dispatch_service).

deploy/userdata/init-host.sh.why: #300 stack-output key substring match. Unchanged by #315. Only needed if the customer hasn't picked up #300. Running hosts already booted — only affects future scale-out.

host-role dynamodb:GetItem on openclaw-t.why: #307/#308 fail-closed prerequisite of the launch-vm token fallback. A 266 customer may already have it. Command inline in APPLY Step 2.

applies_when.dispatch.mode == ddb: the #315 dispatch fix applies and is REQUIRED
applies_when.scaler.lifecycle_queue_enabled == true: openclaw-lifecycle-consumer exists and must be updated
applies_when.create_via_queue == false: create does NOT use the consumer — verify the consumer via rebuild/delete, not create
applies_when.logging.enabled == false: AOS not deployed -> Secrets Manager VPCE NOT needed (no network layer)
